name: Xiadun Jue
source:
[i]"Everyone's desperate to get close to Mr. Mun. Hah. Filthy hyenas."[/i]

[i]Devotee of the Guiding Light[/i]

Mun's right-hand man. He supports Mun not only as a member of the mafia, but acts as an excellent secretary for Sodyk Real Estate.

He has the utmost respect for Mun, and works hard to realize his ideals. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
